name: Re-Engage
source:
It was all known on that day... that cool August day when the shadow of fall slipped over a summer afternoon that felt like it might never end...

The sequel to otome ADV game "Sugardrop Breakout".

[From DLsite]
translation:
一切都在那一天揭晓了……那个凉爽的八月之日，秋天的阴影悄然掠过了仿佛永远不会结束的夏日午后……

乙女ADV游戏《Sugardrop Breakout》的续作。
